links.reported_relation: Constructor pre-sets totalSupply = 1 000 000 with zero assets and totalAssets evaluates to 1 at first fulfilment, so shares minted are inflated relative to the required zero-supply bootstrap.
Bootstrap supply without assets combined with a near-zero denominator in fulfilment math drives the wrong share accounting.
Math.mulDiv with the 1-wei denominator inflates/devalues shares and assets, making share-price-dependent fee, NAV and integration logic wrong.
